failing.summary: RELEASE.md:5 (raised by opus as its dc-01): RELEASE.md quotes: "My laptop and my cloud session count as me, so they never lock each other out." The code does the opposite on purpose (decision 33 of itd-2609091034175565, internal/core/claim/remote.go:262). A second copy held by the same person is refused at exit 3: "you are already building <id> on another computer, until <expiry>; pass --take-over to continue here". A footprint that overlaps the person's own reservation from another copy is also refused at exit 3. Both were reproduced live with two clones under one GitHub username. reserve.md:60,72-76 and build --help describe this correctly. The quote comes from the intent's PR/FAQ, which was written before decision 33, so fix it at that source too (intent line 30). Suggested text: "My laptop and my cloud session count as me, and moving a piece of work from one to the other is one flag."
